scope: Fifteenth bounded target-specific wave: 12 current completion-unproved Control Room targets; all 12 conservatively retained unproved after immutable OSS source review.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.

ONEUPTIME.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; cloud, commercial, paid, private, hosted and unpinned behavior is excluded.

ZULIP.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted realm configuration, private deployments and unpinned behavior are excluded.

FRIGATE.edition_boundary: Pinned public community repository source only; Frigate+, hosted services, external models, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

AWX.edition_boundary: Pinned official AWX community repository source only; Automation Controller, hosted, commercial, private and unpinned behavior is excluded.
